discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology has changed the treatment of diabetes and obesity worldwide, and the work is now showing cardiovascular and kidney benefits. The field has been recognized with the 2024 Lasker, the Breakthrough Prize and the Gairdner, and the 2025 prize (immune tolerance) did not overlap with it. Habener and Mojsov identified and characterized GLP-1(7-37) and its insulinotropic activity, and Knudsen led the development of long-acting analogues.
